name: LS-01 | Fun 001 | LinkedIn Events Sync
description:
# LS-01 | Fun 001 | LinkedIn Events Sync

**Ticket:** [Monday](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/pulses/12418264810)

## What it does
Fetches all lead-gen-enabled events for org 4000016 and stores them in Postgres.

## Details
- Endpoint: `events?q=organizerLeadGenFormEnabledEvents&organizer=urn:li:organization:4000016`
- Table: `marketing.linkedin_events`
- Upsert: ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE (refreshes name/dates)
- API version: 202608
